name: WishCare Hair Growth Serum Concentrate 30ml - 3% Redensyl, 4% Anagain, 2% Baicapil, Caffeine, Biotin & Rice Water - Advanced Hair Growth Serum for Hair Fall Control & Hair Growth 30ml
description:
WishCare Hair Growth Serum Concentrate
For Men & Women – 3% Redensyl, 4% Anagain, 2% Baicapil, Caffeine, Biotin, Plant Keratin & Rice Water

Achieve thicker, fuller, and healthier-looking hair with WishCare Hair Growth Serum, a concentrated formula designed to promote hair density and reduce hair fall.

Key Benefits:

Boosts Hair Growth: Redensyl, Anagain, Baicapil, Biotin, Keratin & Rice Water work together to support hair thickness, density, and vitality.

Reduces Hair Fall: Patented peptides and natural extracts target hair roots, prolong the hair life cycle, and restore hair health.

Lightweight, Leave-On Formula: Non-greasy and easy to apply; penetrates the scalp effectively for maximum results.

Safe & Powerful Ingredients:

Redensyl: Targets stem cells and fibroblasts to improve hair density.

Anagain: Organic pea sprout extract to rebalance the hair life cycle.

Baicapil: Enhances the appearance of hair density.

Clean & Non-Toxic: Cruelty-free, vegan, paraben-free, gluten-free, fragrance-free, and safe for all hair types.
